Name: EH Smash Quality
Author: enghao
Description:
[size=3][b]THIS MOD IS MAIN TARGET FOR ANDROID SV ONLY, although it is runnable on SV1.5, but please consider of [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7907]Quality Smash[/url][b]﻿ from [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3449035]barfytheclown[/url][b] which have better UI and more configurable.[/b][/size]

I love the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7907]Quality Smash[/url] from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3449035]barfytheclown[/url] and this idea was brilliant, so satisfied after smash all item quality. Unfortunately android mod user is not able to enjoy it so i make it my own.

[u][b]Requirements:[/b][/u]
[list=1]
[*]SMAPI 3.7.6+
[/list]
[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Smash all quality item to no-quality item, stack it if available.
[*]Smash all flower into no-quality flower, smash color into first flower color (arrange the order before smash so you can decide color your self).
[*]Auto stash inventory item into chest if the chest have the same "name" item (cross quality but not stack for different quality).
[/list]
[b][u]Notes:[/u][/b]
Unlike [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7907]Quality Smash[/url]﻿, this mod have no option to configure, only way is smash all quality.

[u]How To Use:[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Open chest.
[*]Click [F8] for smash quality.
[*]Click [F9] for auto stash item.
[/list]
[b][u]Config:[/u][/b]
Both key able to configure, the KeyName please refer: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]Stardew Valley Wiki Key Bindings[/url]
The "config.json" will auto generate after enter the game if no config.json file found. You might able to create the config file if you wish.
Default "config.json":
[code]{
  "SmashKey": "F8",
  "StashKey": "F9"
}[/code]
